tasks.title: Canonical day-state model & streak derivation
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical per-day state record is the source of truth for both the daily lock and the streak counter
Streak counter is computed by walking the canonical day-state timeline, never from a separately maintained counter
Unit tests show streak value changes correctly and consistently when the underlying day-state changes

tasks.title: Enforce locked-day immutability
acceptance_criteria: Once a day's canonical state is marked locked, no API path can mutate or delete its check-in data
Attempting to edit or undo a locked day is rejected at the domain layer, not just hidden in the UI
Test covers attempted edit after lock boundary (e.g. after local midnight) and confirms rejection

tasks.title: One-canonical-card-per-day invariant & in-place regeneration
acceptance_criteria: Data layer enforces a unique constraint of at most one canonical card per calendar day
Regenerating a day's card updates the existing record in place (same identity/date key)
Regeneration never inserts a second archive entry for the same day; test asserts archive count is unchanged after N regenerations

tasks.title: Demo history seeding: opt-in, fixed historical range, reset confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Demo mode is off by default on a genuine fresh install; enabling it is an explicit user action
Seeds 30+ days of demo history anchored to a fixed historical date range strictly before any real usage date
Demo dates are structurally incapable of colliding with real check-in dates (e.g. distinct date range/id namespace enforced by the same uniqueness constraint from T-029)
Disabling demo mode surfaces an explicit confirmation that the streak will reset before proceeding

tasks.title: Demo card visual parity with explicit label
acceptance_criteria: Cards generated from demo-seeded inputs render identically to real cards from equivalent inputs, pixel-for-pixel aside from the label
A small, explicit 'Demo' label is the only visual differentiator, present on every demo card and archive thumbnail
Snapshot test compares a demo card and a real card built from equivalent input to confirm no other visual divergence

tasks.title: Four-destination navigation shell
acceptance_criteria: App root navigation exposes exactly four destinations: Today, Archive, Wrapped, Settings
No additional top-level destinations exist or are reachable from the root nav

tasks.title: Scrollable archive grid (real + demo cards)
acceptance_criteria: Archive tab shows a scrollable grid populated with all canonical cards, real and demo-seeded, sourced from the canonical day-state store
Grid performs smoothly with 30+ demo entries plus real entries combined
Each demo entry in the grid carries the demo label from T-019

tasks.title: High-resolution card & Wrapped image renderer (1080x1920) via share sheet
acceptance_criteria: Every individual card and the monthly Wrapped export produce a real static raster image at exactly 1080x1920 pixels
Export path renders from underlying card/layout data (vector/model), not a screenshot capture of live UI — no status bar, nav bar, or system chrome present in output
Export is invoked via the native iOS share sheet
Automated check verifies output pixel dimensions and absence of chrome on a sample export

tasks.title: Strip EXIF/device metadata from exported images
acceptance_criteria: Exported image files contain no EXIF or device metadata (GPS, device model, timestamps beyond what's intentionally embedded)
Test inspects exported file's metadata dictionary and asserts it is empty/stripped

tasks.title: StoreKit 2 Aura+ non-consumable product & entitlement model
acceptance_criteria: A single non-consumable 'Aura+' StoreKit 2 product is defined
Owning the entitlement unlocks exactly three things: watermark-free export, expanded palette library, one regeneration per day — and nothing else
Entitlement state is queryable from a single source of truth used by export, palette, and regeneration features

tasks.title: Free-tier watermark overlay, bundled and non-overlapping
acceptance_criteria: Free-tier exports carry a small, tasteful watermark asset bundled in the app binary — never fetched remotely at export time
Watermark placement is verified to never overlap the card's focal art or caption region across all card layouts
Aura+ entitled users' exports have no watermark, gated via the T-023 entitlement check

tasks.title: Real StoreKit 2 purchase & restore flows with Simulator disclosure
acceptance_criteria: Purchase and restore-purchases flows call the real StoreKit 2 API (Product.purchase(), AppStore.sync()) with no faked/simulated success path in shipping code
A local StoreKit configuration file is provided for Simulator testing
Simulator-specific UI/docs explicitly disclose that Simulator can confirm purchase initiation and local config/restore logic, but not full real transaction completion

tasks.title: Live Transaction.updates entitlement listener
acceptance_criteria: An app-lifetime Transaction.updates listener is registered at launch and kept running, not just a one-time launch-time entitlement check
Entitlement state updates in-app immediately when a transaction update arrives (e.g. renewal, revocation, purchase from another device)

tasks.title: Restore-purchases confirmation messaging
acceptance_criteria: On successful restore, confirmation UI explicitly states that card history/streak remains device-local and is not restored or backed up
This local-data disclosure is visually/textually distinct from the entitlement-restored confirmation, not conflated into one sentence

tasks.title: No cross-device/reinstall continuity messaging
acceptance_criteria: App makes no promise, in UI copy or behavior, that card history/streak syncs across devices or survives reinstall
Settings surfaces a clear statement that restore only returns the Aura+ entitlement, not history or streak
Fresh-install-after-uninstall scenario verified to start with empty local history regardless of prior entitlement restore
